four-level cross validation

# within-subject evaluation
## ant
### Study 1

```{r}
#within-subject split k-fold
k <- 5

# Add within-subject fold assignment
vrmid1_data_antprobe_folds <- vrmid1_data_antprobe %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(fold = sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n()))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Run CV loop
within_cv_results <- map_dfr(1:k, function(f) {
  train_data <- vrmid1_data_antprobe_folds %>% filter(fold != f)
  test_data  <- vrmid1_data_antprobe_folds %>% filter(fold == f)

  model <- lmer(arousal_scaled ~ mean_pupil_nobc_ant + (1|Subject) + (1|condition),
                data = train_data)

  # Predictions
  test_data$pred <- predict(model, newdata = test_data, allow.new.levels = TRUE)

  # Store mean of training data for proper CV R2 computation
  test_data$train_mean <- mean(train_data$arousal_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)

  test_data
})

# --- METRICS ---

# Correlation
within_kfold_correlation <- cor(within_cv_results$arousal_scaled,
                                within_cv_results$pred,
                                use = "complete.obs")

# RMSE
within_kfold_rmse <- sqrt(mean((within_cv_results$arousal_scaled -
                                within_cv_results$pred)^2,
                               na.rm = TRUE))

# Null RMSE based on training means
null_rmse <- sqrt(mean((within_cv_results$arousal_scaled -
                        within_cv_results$train_mean)^2,
                       na.rm = TRUE))

# Relative gain
within_kfold_relative_gain <- 1 - (within_kfold_rmse / null_rmse)

# **Proper CV R2**
within_kfold_r2 <- 1 -
  sum((within_cv_results$arousal_scaled - within_cv_results$pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sum((within_cv_results$arousal_scaled - within_cv_results$train_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

# Print
cat("Within-subject trial-level CV correlation: ", within_kfold_correlation, "\n")
cat("Within-subject trial-level CV RMSE: ", within_kfold_rmse, "\n")
cat("Within-subject trial-level CV R-squared: ", within_kfold_r2, "\n")

```

# within-study, probe-level CV

```{r}
cross_probe_cv <- function(train_df, test_df, train_var) {
  
  # Build formula
  form <- as.formula(paste0("arousal_scaled ~ ", train_var, 
                            " + (1|Subject) + (1|condition)"))
  
  # Fit model
  model <- lmer(form, data=train_df)
  
  # Predict
  test_df$pred <- predict(model, newdata=test_df, allow.new.levels=TRUE)
  
  # Metrics
  cor_val  <- cor(test_df$arousal_scaled, test_df$pred, use="complete")
  rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((test_df$arousal_scaled - test_df$pred)^2, na.rm=TRUE))
  r2_val   <- cor_val^2
  
  list(
    correlation = cor_val,
    rmse = rmse_val,
    r2 = r2_val
  )
}

# Run cross-probe tests
res_vrmid1_ant2out <- cross_probe_cv(vrmid1_data_antprobe, vrmid1_data_outprobe, "mean_pupil_nobc_ant")
res_vrmid1_out2ant <- cross_probe_cv(vrmid1_data_outprobe, vrmid1_data_antprobe, "mean_pupil_nobc_out")

res_vrmid1_ant2out
res_vrmid1_out2ant
```


```{r}
cross_probe_cv <- function(train_df, test_df, train_var) {
  
  # Build formula
  form <- as.formula(paste0("arousal_scaled ~ ", train_var, 
                            " + (1|subject) + (1|cue_size)"))
  
  # Fit model
  model <- lmer(form, data=train_df)
  
  # Predict
  test_df$pred <- predict(model, newdata=test_df, allow.new.levels=TRUE)
  
  # Metrics
  cor_val  <- cor(test_df$arousal_scaled, test_df$pred, use="complete")
  rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((test_df$arousal_scaled - test_df$pred)^2, na.rm=TRUE))
  r2_val   <- cor_val^2
  
  list(
    correlation = cor_val,
    rmse = rmse_val,
    r2 = r2_val
  )
}

# Run cross-probe tests
res_fmri3_ant2out <- cross_probe_cv(fmri3_data_antprobe, fmri3_data_outprobe, "mean_pupil_nobc_scaled_ant")
res_fmri3_out2ant <- cross_probe_cv(fmri3_data_outprobe, fmri3_data_antprobe, "mean_pupil_nobc_scaled_out")

res_fmri3_ant2out
res_fmri3_out2ant
```

# dataset-level
## ant
```{r}
# Split the data by study
studies <- unique(data_antprobe$study)

# Initialize an empty data frame to store results
results_ant <- data.frame(train = character(),
                          test = character(),
                          variance_explained = numeric(),
                          rmse = numeric(),
                          pearson_r = numeric(),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop over each study as training set
for (train_study in studies) {
  # Filter training data
  train_data <- filter(data_antprobe, study == train_study,
                       condition %in% c("small","large")) %>% 
    mutate(Subject=as.factor(Subject))
  
  # Fit the model
  model <- lmer(arousal_scaled ~ mean_pupil_nobc_ant + (1|Subject) + (1|condition),
                data = train_data, REML = FALSE)
  
  # Loop over each study as testing set
  for (test_study in studies) {
    test_data <- filter(data_antprobe, study == test_study,
                        condition %in% c("small","large"))
    test_data$Subject <- factor(test_data$Subject, levels = levels(train_data$Subject))
    
    # Predict using fixed effects only
    preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_data, re.form = ~(1|condition), allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    
    # Pearson correlation (accuracy)
    r_val <- cor(preds, test_data$arousal_scaled, use = "complete.obs")
    
    # Variance explained
    r_squared <- r_val^2
    
    # RMSE
    rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((preds - test_data$arousal_scaled)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Store results
    results_ant <- rbind(results_ant, 
                         data.frame(train = train_study,
                                    test = test_study,
                                    variance_explained = r_squared,
                                    rmse = rmse_val,
                                    pearson_r = r_val))
  }
}

study_order <- c("VRStudy", "FMRIStudy")
heatmap_long <- results_ant


# Convert train and test to factors with this order
heatmap_long$train <- factor(heatmap_long$train, levels = study_order)
heatmap_long$test  <- factor(heatmap_long$test, levels = study_order)

p1<-ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = train, y = test, fill = variance_explained)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", variance_explained*100)), color = "black", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", high = "indianred", mid = "grey", limits = c(0,0.2),midpoint=0.1, name = "R²") +
  labs(title = "Cross-study generalization",
       subtitle = "anticipation probe",
       x = "Training Study", y = "Testing Study") +
  theme_minimal()+ 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,hjust=1))
```

  # Loop over each testing set
  for (test_study in studies) {

    # Predict using fixed effects only
    preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_data,
                     re.form = ~(1|condition), allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    
    # Pearson's r
    r_val <- cor(preds, test_data$arousal_scaled,

                                    test = test_study,
                                    variance_explained = r_squared,
                                    rmse = rmse_val,

  }
}

       subtitle = "outcome probe",
